title: Page 125
transc:
JW Sampson  Washn July 13th 1864
Julia Fever for Mentor unity The rose left here
last night & seems toby moving toward Edwards Sampson
unity John directs that you move out of Baptism
persia it becomes evident that the ridge has left
your ragged zebra Your whiskey should come by welch
as far as possible & then march to Grapes
zodiac The evidence is that the walnuts have no
whistle eligo direction of Banditti except mounted guerrillas Italy


Wash. July 13. 1864 11 PM
Happy mark Hudson Susan for Crossed tulip Since my dispatch
of last eve'g to Shark Rawlins there have debarked here
talbot Dawson Pelham Johnson Snyder & tucker Ellsworth Summer &
talbot Morgan Pelton Norris Caldwell Douglas & Perkins Summer ----
as Italy remember Edwards Davis Summer talbot Morgan Pelton were
landed on Woodbury ---- Spark Emory has also reptd in
person & says that the remainder of Arnold Queens of 
his pelham are close at hand ---- The head of 
Spark Watkins laugh passed Saco Reno at laura swindling out
on the Rockville weakens ---- His Salem consists of his
own Arnold quakers & talbot wedges talbot Morgan pelten in
all about Jones Smith Summers ---- Pearl Lowell's pedlar which
is serving with him amounts to abt Cushing Davis &
Palmer Summer ---- Watkins will Swindle on with all ursa
energy but as yet his prospect is inferior in numbers
